# hush-hush PHP SDK

> Official PHP SDK for [hush-hush](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush), a
> secret-storage service, generated from its OpenAPI spec. This site is the
> phpDocumentor API reference for the SDK's hand-written public surface —
> `Client`, `RetryPolicy` and the exception types it throws; the generated
> API/model classes underneath aren't part of the published docs.

Install with `composer require alrayyes/hush-hush` (PHP 8.2+). `Client` is
the entry point: construct it with a base URL and API key, then call
create/get/update/delete on objects or query the audit log.

## Docs

- [API reference home](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-php/index.html): entry point to the generated phpDocumentor site.
- [Client](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-php/classes/HushHush-Client.html): the SDK's main entry point — create, get, update, delete objects, and query the audit log.
- [RetryPolicy](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-php/classes/HushHush-RetryPolicy.html): configures retry/backoff behavior for the underlying Guzzle HTTP client.
- [Exceptions](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-php/namespaces/hushhush-exception.html): `ApiException` and `HushHushException`, thrown by `Client` calls.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush-php): source, README quickstart, and CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [Packagist package](https://packagist.org/packages/alrayyes/hush-hush): install instructions and release history.
